name: claude-companion-kit
description: Companion mods for Claude Code: a band above the prompt for the task, limits and cache, and a side pane of what each chat used and cost

plugins.name: taskband
plugins.description: A slim band above the prompt with the task's progress and creds, the 5-hour limit, and a prompt-cache countdown that forecasts a cold send; /keepwarm keeps the cache warm through breaks

plugins.name: chat-monitor
plugins.description: A side pane of what this chat used and cost: the session's total, the to-do list, connectors, web, subagents, files, skills and what loads into every message; /chat-monitor opens it
